newsitem.title: SAN MARINO: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SAN MARINO V NETHERLANDS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SAN MARINO V NETHERLANDS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group seven qualifier between San Marino and The Netherlands on Wednesday:

San Marino: 1-Federico Gasperoni, 2-Mauro Valentini, 3-Damiano Vannucci, 4-Luca Gobbi, 5-William Guerra, 6-Matteoni, 7-Bryan Gasperoni, 8-Marco Mazza, 9-Paolo Montagna, 10-Fabio Francini, 11-Riccardo Muccioli.

Netherlands: 1-Edwin van der Sar, 2-Aron Winter, 3-Jaap Stam, 4-Frank de Boer, 5-Arthur Numan, 6-Wim Jonk, 7-Pierre van Hooijdonk, 8-Ronald de Boer, 9-Dennis Bergkamp, 10-Clarence Seedorf, 11-Boudewijn Zenden.
